text:
maya: Heads-up: Product asked if Console notifications for audit exports should include requester name. I'm worried about email archives leaking PII.
ethan: +1 on avoiding raw display names in notif. Presigned links can be forwarded.
priya: Product case: compliance ops often triage from the toast without opening download. Need at least some context.
jordi: Proposal: notif shows a non-identifying actor_label (eg. "Requester: Team admin" or "Requester: internal alias x4f") ; Console download modal shows full name after entitlement check.
legal: if it's in email bodies it becomes part of customer records. We prefer hashed aliases in any out-of-system channel.
maya: ok so notif == actor_label (human friendly, not PII). Telemetry stores actor_hash for dashboards.
ethan: Implementation detail: do NOT include presign_url in webhook/notification payload. Return a download_token and require server side exchange for presign (entitlement enforced).
priya: UX nuance: can we show a rounded event count like "~2k events" in notif? helps triage without exact numbers.
jordi: Rounded buckets only. Also add a per-tenant debounce so repeated clicks within 30s don't enqueue duplicate exports.
maya: quota side: we need per-tenant concurrent export cap + monthly budget tracking. Suggest: concurrent=3, monthly_bytes_limit default off but admin-configurable.
ethan: Telemetry events to emit: 
- export.requested (export_id, actor_hash, tenant_id, bucket_estimate)
- export.enqueued (export_id, queue_pos)
- export.started (export_id, worker_id)
- export.completed (export_id, size_bytes, event_count_bucket)
- export.failed (export_id, failure_code)
- export.cancelled (export_id, actor_hash)
Make actor_hash optional in completion if external downloader triggers download (privacy).
priya: For Console copy: Toast text should read: "Your export is queued (requested by a team member). Check Audit > Exports for details." Hover or details link shows full requester if user has audit:view entitlement.
legal: also require a privacy flag for exports: include_pii=true/false so downstream processors know. Default false.
jordi: We'll need API changes: POST /v1/exports returns { export_id, status, actor_label, download_token } (no presign). Then GET /v1/exports/:id/presign?token=xxx validates entitlement and returns presign_url.
maya: can we prototype with a 2-week internal beta? Canary to 5% tenants first. Monitor metrics: export.requested rate, export.duplicate_clicks, notif_delivery_failures.
audit-bot: SYSTEM: emitted export.requested (export_id=e-2021, actor_hash=ah_f3, tenant=t-42, bucket_estimate="~2k")
ethan: Action items:
- ethan: implement download_token/presign exchange & debounce (ETA 2d)
- jordi: quota + monthly budget enforcement + telemetry hooks (ETA 4d)
- priya: toast wording + admin toggle for notif verbosity (ETA 1d)
- legal: confirm email template redaction guidance (ETA 2d)
maya: tagging: we'll gate on audit:view entitlement for showing names. If no entitlement, show alias. Canary next sprint.
priya: I'll draft notif templates and add examples for internal vs external channels.
ethan: also adding rate-limit header X-Export-Quota-Remaining in API responses so clients can surface remaining budget.
jordi: We'll add export.retry_count metric and surface failed_reason for ops only.
maya: great, thanks everyone. We'll sync after the beta is running. :rocket:
